description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - The First meeting to elect the Vice Chairman of the Tumpane Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content announces the first meeting to elect the Vice Chairman of the Thumpane Pradeshiya Sabha, which is an electoral process matter under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically references Section 66 g of the amended Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and provides details about the meeting date, time, and location for this electoral procedure. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral processes and related matters for local authorities.
